about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Spreading the gospel through music since 2010
about.historyText: AIC Chang'ombe Choir (CVC) was founded in 2010 in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. What started as a small group of passionate worship leaders has grown into one of Tanzania's most beloved gospel choirs. We have released multiple albums, performed at major events, and touched thousands of lives through our music ministry.
about.missionText: To spread the gospel of Jesus Christ through powerful worship music, reaching hearts across Tanzania and beyond. We aim to create an atmosphere of worship that transforms lives and brings people closer to God.
about.visionText: To be the leading gospel choir in East Africa, producing world-class worship music that glorifies God and inspires believers. We envision a ministry that empowers worship leaders, supports local artists, and creates a sustainable platform for gospel music in Tanzania.
